title: agent-watcher: expose Claude Code session status
description:
A live process does not mean a working agent, but Claude Code records the difference. `~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json` has a `status` field. In a `claude -p` stream-json run it went `busy`, `waiting` during a pending approval, `busy`, then `idle`. `scanner.SessionDescriptor` reads `Status`, and `discover` then discards it.

Change:
- Parse `statusUpdatedAt` and `entrypoint`.
- Carry them through the snapshot API.
- Map status to working, waiting, idle or unknown.

Constraints:
- The field is undocumented and was measured on one version, 2.1.310. Unrecognized values map to unknown.
- `shell` also appears on interactive sessions and its meaning is not established.
- Headless sessions report `kind: interactive`, so use `entrypoint: sdk-cli` to identify them.
